$description: creative marketing tokens: display type on clamp(), section rhythm, hero sizes, marketing radius roles, surfaces (glass, grain, scrim), seam gradients, hero CTA. Extends ../../ui/09-design-tokens/04-reference-token-schema.md (DTCG 2025.10, org.design-deep-dive.llm); does NOT replace ui tokens for service screens and does NOT touch ui type.page-title-lg (landing-h1). Fluid values: DTCG dimension has only px/rem, so $value holds the size at 1440 px and $extensions.org.design-deep-dive.fluid holds min, max, viewport range and the compiled clamp(). Brand values (font families, colors) are defaults to be overridden by art-direction.tokens_extension. Motion tokens: group motion.marketing.

org.design-deep-dive.meta.wcag_1_4_4_rule: every fluid text size has max <= 2.5 x min (Barvian 2023; verified by zoom emulation)

display.$description: Default display family (OFL, Cyrillic full). Replace from art-direction.visual_language.type.display; check cyrillic-display-fonts.yaml first.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED: pick from cyrillic-display-fonts.yaml entries with default_or_option = default or caution. Do NOT use families listed under avoid or no_cyrillic for Russian pages. MUST declare a metric fallback @font-face (size-adjust from k_ru) to keep CLS at 0.

text.$description: Default text family for leads and body on marketing pages.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED default for body and lead. Use the display family for body only if its entry lists body in good_for.

mono.$description: Outlier family for data, code and measurements only.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use in at most 2 slots per page (Hallmark 2+1 rule). Do NOT use as a costume for a technical look.

display-poster.$description: Poster statement or footer wordmark: 1-2 words, <= 12 characters total. 64 -> 160 px (360 -> 1440).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use only for 1-2 words (<= 12 characters) at L1-L2. For a brand wordmark in the footer prefer an SVG logotype. Do NOT use for a sentence headline: a 34-character headline at this size breaks into 4+ lines.

display-xl.$description: Hero statement up to 20 characters (text-only or text-over hero). 48 -> 120 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use when the H1 has <= 20 characters and the column is >= 960 px wide. With a wide face (k > 0.65, e.g. Unbounded) step down to display-l. Letter-spacing MUST stay >= tracking_touch + 0.005 em of the chosen face (cyrillic-display-fonts.yaml).

display-l.$description: Hero H1 of 21-38 characters in a text-only or text-over hero (column up to 1040 px). 40 -> 96 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED default for a hero H1 of median length (34 characters in Russian) when text is not beside media. MUST fit in <= 2 lines at 1440 px and <= 4 lines at 390 px; if not, step down to display-m. Do NOT use in a split (text-left/right) hero.

display-m.$description: Hero H1 beside media (split, column ~600 px) up to 36 characters, or text-only H1 of 39-56 characters. 36 -> 64 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED for split heroes (text_media text-left or text-right). Also for the title of a peak section. Longer headlines (> 56 characters) MUST be shortened by copy (text), not squeezed.

display-s.$description: Display section title (H2) and the fallback for long H1. 30 -> 56 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED default for H2 of marketing sections (28 characters median). Use one display size for all H2 of a page; peaks may use display-m.

display-quote.$description: Pull quote fragment up to 120 characters. 26 -> 44 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use for a quoted fragment only; the full testimonial stays in body size. Do NOT set longer than 3 lines at 1440 px.

lead-hero.$description: Hero subheadline. 18 -> 22 px, measure <= 34em desktop, 27ch phone.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: MUST keep 4.5:1 contrast on media (it is smaller than large text). Hold to <= 3 lines at 1440 px and <= 4 at 390 px; longer copy is shortened by text, not shrunk.

eyebrow.$description: Eyebrow in sentence case (Russian default). Fixed size, no clamp.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED default for Russian: sentence case, 14-16 px, weight 500-600. At most one eyebrow per 3 sections, hero included (text copy-slots.yaml, taste). On media the eyebrow sets the scrim alpha: MUST reach 4.5:1.
Use only when the art direction chooses a caps register; Cyrillic caps read worse than Latin caps (ui 02/03 §2.5). Do NOT place caps eyebrows above every heading.

cta-hero.$description: Label of the hero CTA button (size tokens under size.cta-hero-*).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Label MUST fit one line (<= 25 Russian characters, text copy-slots.yaml). Use 17-18 px, the same as or 1 step above body.
MUST be 16 px or more on phones. Full-bleed media ignores it; text never does.

section-s.$description: Compact floor gap (logo wall, stat strip, sticky-stack step). 48 -> 64 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use for short supporting sections and between two sections on the same background.

section-m.$description: Default floor gap between marketing sections. 64 -> 112 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED default padding-block of a section. Do NOT use ui space.stack.section (24 px) between marketing sections. Padding-bottom may be up to 1.3x padding-top (hero, Birman floors).

section-l.$description: Pause, manifesto, peak entry, change of background. 80 -> 160 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use for visual_role pause and for the first section after a background change. At most 1 in 3 sections: large gaps everywhere read as an empty template (NN/g: pages are too sparse).

stack-display.$description: Gap between a display heading and its lead. 16 -> 24 px (0.25-0.4 em of the heading).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Keep smaller than the half-leading gap between lines of the heading x 3; increasing the heading size does NOT automatically increase this gap (Birman).

container.$description: Marketing content container (Carbon Editorial model: centred).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use for text and grids; full-bleed media spans the viewport, the text column never exceeds 1040 px.

hero-text-max.$description: Max width of the H1 column in text-only and text-over heroes.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use as max-width of the hero headline block. In split heroes the text column is 5-6 of 12 columns (about 560-640 px at 1440).

hero-min-offer.$description: Hero box for first_screen_policy offer-cta: 60-85 % of viewport height, content fits 800 px.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: MUST leave the top edge of the next section visible at 1440x900 and 1280x800. Do NOT use 100vh or dvh for the hero box.

hero-min-poster.$description: Hero box for first_screen_policy poster (campaign L2, portfolio, letter): up to the full small viewport.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use only with the site policy poster and a visible continuation cue; never for paid-search landing pages.
Use for the one primary CTA of the hero and the final CTA band; other buttons stay on ui sizes (24-48). Padding-inline = 2x padding-block (Purdila).

measure-lead.$description: Lead measure: 34em of the lead size (748 px at 22 px, about 65 Russian characters), 27ch on phones over media.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use max-width: 34em for leads; body text follows ui 02/03 §3 (65ch).
Pick ONE radius family per page: sharp (0), soft (12-24) or pill for interactive only (taste shape lock).

media.$description: Photos, video, product frames in soft systems.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use 12-16 for media; nested elements use radius minus padding.
Use 16-24 for large tiles; a non-clickable marketing card has no hover elevation (ux 04/04 §3.1 caution).

cta-hero.$description: Pill hero CTA in soft or pill systems; in a sharp system use radius.none.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use pill only for interactive controls; do NOT mix a pill CTA with sharp cards unless the rule is documented in art-direction.

base.$description: Page surface (default; override from art-direction palette.background).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: RECOMMENDED chroma <= 0.03 for areas > 30 % of the screen at L0 (ui 01/06 §1.7); L1-L2 may exceed it for a committed or drenched strategy with contrast checked.

tint.$description: Tinted section in the same family as base (delta L 2-4 %).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use for rhythm inside one theme; the tint MUST come from the brand hue family, not a random second hue.

inverse.$description: Inverse section (dark pause on a light page).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use as a deliberate pause or the final CTA; at most 2 inversions per page (one pause + one finale or footer) unless the page theme is mixed by art direction.

on-inverse.$description: Text on inverse and dark media.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: MUST reach 4.5:1 on the lightest point behind it (F83).

dark.$description: Dark scrim edge alpha under light text (ai-media 10/03 §2.2).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use as a gradient under the text column only (0.62 at the edge -> 0 at 64-68 %); the alpha is set by the smallest text in the zone. Do NOT lay a flat 0.5 box (grey box).
Use under dark text on light frames; on phones the scrim runs top-down.

glass-light.$description: Glass layer on busy content: >= 72 % opacity with blur >= 12 px (ui 11/01 §6).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use for 1-2 layers per viewport as a performance budget (cost — creative 06/03); text on glass MUST pass 4.5:1 against the worst backdrop. Do NOT use glass on the sticky header while it is transparent over the hero.
Same limits as glass-light.

grain-soft.$description: Grain overlay opacity (SVG feTurbulence 280 B, mix-blend-mode soft-light), under text.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use 0.05-0.09 on photos and CSS gradients; grain >= 0.10 only to hide banding of raster gradients (ai-media 10/03 §4.3). Do NOT grain a page that already has a paper texture.

seam-to-next.$description: Seam at the bottom of a media hero into the next section colour, 96-120 px tall (ai-media 10/03 §4.2).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use CSS gradients for seams (0 bytes, no banding). The end colour MUST equal the next section background token.

under-nav.$description: 140 px top gradient under a transparent header over media.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: MUST be present when header.variant = transparent-over-hero sits on a photo or video, so header links reach 4.5:1.

cta-glow.$description: Coloured glow under the hero CTA (accent hue); replace colour with the brand accent.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use only on the single hero or final CTA on a dark or tinted surface, when art-direction lists glow as a decision; offset and blur are required (a zero-offset halo is decoration, impeccable). Do NOT glow on white backgrounds.

marketing.$description: Marketing motion tokens: durations by presentation role, stagger, easings, distances, scales, scroll scene lengths, loop speeds and loop loudness; the attention budget by ambition level lives in ../01-creative-direction/ambition-levels.yaml#levels.motion_hints. Interface feedback of controls stays on ui 08-motion tokens; these tokens drive presentation (scenes, reveals, loops, scroll). Every token carries its prefers-reduced-motion value in $extensions.org.design-deep-dive.reduce (resolver modifier 'motion: reduced', ui 08/03 §5.3). CSS: --motion-marketing-* in marketing-tokens.css; the variable name is the token path joined with hyphens, as the design-system build names it (scripts/project/ds_build.py): motion.marketing.duration.reveal -> --motion-marketing-duration-reveal.

org.design-deep-dive.meta.reduce_rule: reduce, not remove: spatial values -> 0 or 1, stagger -> 0, reveal and scene durations -> crossfade 180 ms or instant, loops paused, scroll-linked -> stations or final state

feedback.$description: Press, color change of controls. Range 100-160 ms (Emil; ui Interactions 50-150).

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Use for direct feedback only; never animate focus rings (0 ms).

hover.$description: Hover lift 1-2 px, underline, highlight. Range 150-250 ms; leave up to 1.5x.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Gate motion with @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine). In reduce keep color, drop the lift.

reveal.$description: One-time reveal of an element on scroll. Range 400-700 ms.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Fire once; start from opacity .01 (never 0) and translateY(shift-reveal); content visible without JS; not on the LCP element.

split-line.$description: One line or word of a split display heading. Range 600-900 ms.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: Display roles only, never the LCP heading; total with stagger <= split-total-max.

split-total-max.$description: Ceiling for a whole split heading reveal including stagger.

hero-scene.$description: Whole first-screen entrance scene (all elements). Range 600-1200 ms.

org.design-deep-dive.llm.rules: LCP element (H1 or poster) has no animation or transform only.

state.$description: In-page state change, same-document View Transition. Range 250-400 ms.

page.$description: Page transition (SPA View Transitions, Barba, Swup). Range 300-500 ms; multipage repeats 250-400 ms.

counter.$description: Count-up of a proof number, once, <= 1500 ms, tabular-nums, final number in HTML.

cta-pulse.$description: One attention pulse of the CTA on an event; at most 2 pulses, whole series < 5 s.

intro-max.$description: Ceiling of an L2-campaign intro; Skip visible from the first second; none on repeat visits and in reduce.

crossfade-reduce.$description: Opacity-only crossfade used instead of spatial motion under reduce (<= 200 ms).

loop-autostop.$description: A loop without a pause button stops after this plus the end of its cycle (WCAG 2.2.2 stops-within-5s).

settle-max.$description: Max scroll settle tail per wheel step with smooth scrolling (creative 03: 800-1400 ms on Lenis sites).

breathe-period.$description: Default period of a breathing background or floating object. The forbidden band, the minimum period and what counts as a large object are gate thresholds: ../09-ai-execution-evaluation/effect-gates.yaml#EG-A11Y-18.

vt-timeout-chrome.$description: Reference only: Chrome skips a cross-document View Transition if navigation takes longer (TimeoutError).

text.$description: Step between lines or words of a split heading (40-80 ms).

group.$description: Step between items of a list-like group (40-80 ms); first 6-8 items only.

group-total-max.$description: Ceiling of the whole cascade of one group.

in.$description: Leaving for good; duration about 75 % of the entrance.

breathe.$description: Sine in-out for breathing loops (period >= breathe-period).

shift-hero.$description: Max travel of first-screen elements; the LCP heading may use transform only up to this.

lift-hover.$description: Card and button hover lift (ui: 1-2 px, not scale).

magnet-max.$description: Max offset of a magnetic CTA toward the pointer; hover:hover and pointer:fine only.

reveal-in.$description: Start scale of a scale-in reveal (never 0).

cta-pulse-peak.$description: Peak of an event pulse (<= 1.05); infinite pulsing is forbidden.

scroll-max-per-100vh.$description: Max scale change per 100vh of scroll for objects >= 50 % of the viewport.

step-vh.$description: Default scroll length of one scene step in vh (100-150) while steps x step length fits the pin limit of the level (pin-l1-max-vh, pin-l2-max-vh); the pin limit is the canonical number, more steps mean a shorter step; each step ends on a readable station.

pin-l1-max-vh.$description: L1: one pinned scene, total scroll length in vh. Canonical pin limit of the level: the effects catalog and the checks refer to this token.

pin-l2-max-vh.$description: L2: max scroll length of one pinned section in vh. Canonical pin limit of the level: the steps share this length (steps x step length <= this value); the effects catalog and the checks refer to this token.

pin-beats-max-vh.$description: Beats scroll mode (pinned scene window, text cards scroll over it, the scene plays each beat to its rest point): max scroll length of the pinned field in vh at L2; 5-7 rest points, step 0.5-0.6 of the viewport (creative 05-motion/02 §4.1.1). Scrub pins keep pin-l2-max-vh.

parallax-ratio-max.$description: Max speed difference between parallax layers; background <= 24vh per 100vh of scroll; text never.

lenis-lerp.$description: Lenis lerp for L2 smooth scrolling. Measured wheel-step tail (motion_check.py 0.1.3, desktop Chromium 153, 2026-09-25): 0.10 -> 1.28 s, 0.12 -> 1.09-1.13 s (fails the 1.0 s gate), 0.15 -> 0.90 s, 0.20 -> 0.72 s; the 99 % formula (0.6 s at 0.12) underestimates. Lenis disables itself under reduce (respectReducedMotion).

marquee-speed.$description: Default marquee speed in px/s, within the effect limits (../06-effects-catalog/effects.yaml#marquee-logos: speed_px_s_min..speed_px_s_max). Period = track width / speed.

float-amplitude-pct.$description: Floating or breathing amplitude, % of object height (2-4).

breathe-pixels-pct-max.$description: Share of viewport pixels changing per second of idle for a breathing layer allowed under display text (creative 03/02: 0.4-2.4 %).

loud-pixels-pct.$description: Above this a loop is loud: first screen of L2 only, pause visible, no text without scrim (creative 03/02: Squarespace 9.5 %).
